Method of Attack: Delivered via emails carrying malicious Microsoft Office documents tailored for each victim
Extracted files (updater.mod and glue30.dll) establish communication with C2 server, persistence, integrity, and keylogging
Uses myDrive cloud storage service for sending commands, modules, and exfiltrated data
Modules can prepare data for exfiltration, run commands from C2, steal email credentials and messages
Capabilities include deleting itself, taking screenshots, injecting shellcode into Internet Explorer, scanning local network, login brute-forcing, exfiltrating data, setting DHCP and DNS settings
Impacted Systems: Civilian and military organizations in Syria
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Office documents
Indicators of Compromise: Files updater.mod and glue30.dll extracted on compromised machines
Use of myDrive cloud storage accounts created per compromised machine
Signature matching in NSA leaked scanner script sigs.py
Malware samples compiled shortly before delivery with newest executable version
